name: Umi Takahashi
source:
Even without hearing all the rumours, Umi strikes Mimi as one to watch out for.

An assertive girl who is not afraid of a good fight, Mimi sees her as compelling material for an antagonist.

[From [url=http://www.stardust-soda.com/through-the-panels/]official website[/url]]

Born in 1996.
Orientation: Bisexual.
Hometown: Tokyo, Japan.
